title: Opinions and discussion
focus: 观点 认为 同意 反对 讨论 说服 立场 角度 原则 建议 支持 怀疑 承认 强调 误会 争论 有道理 说实话 我倒觉得
body:
# Opinions and discussion

Family talk runs on 我觉得 and 对 / 不对. Adult discussion needs more: words for stating a position, conceding a point, pushing back politely and naming a disagreement. These are the words you hear in meetings, debates and any serious conversation.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 观点 | guāndiǎn | point of view / opinion (a stated position on an issue) |
| 认为 | rènwéi | to believe / hold that (considered opinion) |
| 同意 | tóngyì | to agree (with a person or proposal) |
| 反对 | fǎnduì | to oppose / be against |
| 讨论 | tǎolùn | to discuss (a topic, as a group) |
| 说服 | shuōfú | to persuade / convince (someone) |
| 立场 | lìchǎng | stance / position (on an issue) |
| 角度 | jiǎodù | angle / perspective (look at it from another ___) |
| 原则 | yuánzé | principle (a matter of ___) |
| 建议 | jiànyì | suggestion / to suggest |
| 支持 | zhīchí | to support / back (a person, a decision) |
| 怀疑 | huáiyí | to doubt / suspect (that something is so) |
| 承认 | chéngrèn | to admit / acknowledge (a mistake, a fact) |
| 强调 | qiángdiào | to emphasize / stress |
| 误会 | wùhuì | to misunderstand / a misunderstanding (between people) |
| 争论 | zhēnglùn | to argue / debate (over an issue) |
| 有道理 | yǒu dàolǐ | to make sense / have a point (what you say ___) |
| 说实话 | shuō shíhuà | to be honest… (sentence opener) |
| 我倒觉得 | wǒ dào juéde | Actually, I think… (mild contrast with what was just said) |
| 意见 | yìjiàn | objection / complaint (to have a problem with someone) |
| 共识 | gòngshí | consensus (reach a ___) |
| 让步 | ràngbù | to give ground / make a concession |
| 客观 | kèguān | objective / unbiased |
| 指出 | zhǐchū | to point out (a problem, a mistake) |
| 质疑 | zhìyí | to openly question / challenge (a claim, data) |
| 有争议 | yǒu zhēngyì | controversial / disputed |
| 片面 | piànmiàn | one-sided (of a view or argument) |

## Which word?

- **认为 vs 觉得.** Both mean "think". 觉得 is a feeling or impression; 认为 is a reasoned judgment and sounds more serious. Use 认为 when you state a position at work or in a debate.
- **观点 vs 立场 vs 意见.** 观点 is your view on an issue. 立场 is the side you take, firmer and often official. 意见 can mean opinion, but 对他有意见 means you have a problem with him.
- **怀疑 vs 质疑.** 怀疑 is private doubt or suspicion. 质疑 is openly challenging a claim, usually formal.
- **讨论 vs 商量 vs 争论.** 讨论 = talk a topic through. 商量 = work out a decision together. 争论 = argue opposing sides.
- **说服 vs 劝.** 说服 means you succeed in changing their mind. 劝 means you try to talk them into or out of something.

## Examples

- 我认为这件事没那么简单。 wǒ rènwéi zhè jiàn shì méi nàme jiǎndān: I think this is not that simple
- 你说的也有道理,不过我还是反对。 nǐ shuō de yě yǒu dàolǐ, búguò wǒ háishi fǎnduì: You have a point, but I'm still against it
- 从老板的角度来看,这样做风险太大。 cóng lǎobǎn de jiǎodù lái kàn, zhèyàng zuò fēngxiǎn tài dà: From the boss's perspective, it's too risky
- 我们讨论了一下午,还是没达成共识。 wǒmen tǎolùn le yí xiàwǔ, háishi méi dáchéng gòngshí: We discussed it all afternoon and still didn't reach a consensus
- 说实话,我有点怀疑他的动机。 shuō shíhuà, wǒ yǒudiǎn huáiyí tā de dòngjī: To be honest, I'm a bit suspicious of his motives
- 她最后还是被我说服了。 tā zuìhòu háishi bèi wǒ shuōfú le: In the end I convinced her
- 别误会,我不是在批评你。 bié wùhuì, wǒ bú shì zài pīpíng nǐ: Don't get me wrong, I'm not criticizing you
- 我倒觉得这是个好机会。 wǒ dào juéde zhè shì ge hǎo jīhuì: Actually, I think it's a good opportunity
- 他从来不承认自己有错。 tā cónglái bù chéngrèn zìjǐ yǒu cuò: He never admits he's wrong

cards.English: point of view / opinion (a stated position on an issue)
cards.Example: 我不太同意你的观点。 wǒ bú tài tóngyì nǐ de guāndiǎn: I don't really agree with your point of view
cards.Notes: 观点 is a position on an issue; 看法 is the everyday 'take' (你怎么看?).

cards.English: to believe / hold that (considered opinion)
cards.Example: 我认为这个方案可行。 wǒ rènwéi zhège fāng'àn kěxíng: I believe this plan is workable
cards.Notes: 认为 sounds more reasoned and formal than 觉得, which is a gut feeling.

cards.English: to agree (with a person or proposal)
cards.Example: 你同意的话,我们就这么定了。 nǐ tóngyì de huà, wǒmen jiù zhème dìng le: If you agree, then it's settled
cards.Notes: 同意 = agree / give consent; 赞成 is more formal 'be in favor of'.

cards.English: to oppose / be against
cards.Example: 很多人反对这个政策。 hěn duō rén fǎnduì zhège zhèngcè: A lot of people oppose this policy
cards.Notes: Opposite of 支持 or 赞成. 坚决反对 = firmly oppose.

cards.English: to discuss (a topic, as a group)
cards.Example: 这个问题我们明天开会再讨论。 zhège wèntí wǒmen míngtiān kāihuì zài tǎolùn: Let's discuss this at tomorrow's meeting
cards.Notes: 讨论 = talk through a topic; 商量 = talk over to decide something together.

cards.English: to persuade / convince (someone)
cards.Example: 我说服不了他。 wǒ shuōfú bù liǎo tā: I can't convince him
cards.Notes: 被说服了 = be convinced. 劝 is gentler: to urge or advise someone.

cards.English: stance / position (on an issue)
cards.Example: 公司的立场很明确。 gōngsī de lìchǎng hěn míngquè: The company's position is clear
cards.Notes: 站在…的立场 = from …'s standpoint. Firmer and more formal than 观点.

cards.English: angle / perspective (look at it from another ___)
cards.Example: 你换个角度想想。 nǐ huàn ge jiǎodù xiǎngxiang: Try looking at it from another angle
cards.Notes: 从…的角度来看 = from the perspective of …

cards.English: principle (a matter of ___)
cards.Example: 这是原则问题,不能让步。 zhè shì yuánzé wèntí, bù néng ràngbù: This is a matter of principle, I can't give ground
cards.Notes: 原则上 = in principle (usually followed by a 'but').

cards.English: suggestion / to suggest
cards.Example: 我建议你先问问医生。 wǒ jiànyì nǐ xiān wènwen yīshēng: I suggest you ask a doctor first
cards.Notes: 建议 works as a verb and a noun. 提建议 = make a suggestion.

cards.English: to support / back (a person, a decision)
cards.Example: 不管你做什么决定,我都支持你。 bùguǎn nǐ zuò shénme juédìng, wǒ dōu zhīchí nǐ: Whatever you decide, I'll support you

cards.English: to doubt / suspect (that something is so)
cards.Example: 我怀疑他根本没看邮件。 wǒ huáiyí tā gēnběn méi kàn yóujiàn: I suspect he didn't even read the email
cards.Notes: 怀疑 means both 'doubt' and 'suspect'; context decides. It is private doubt, unlike 质疑.

cards.English: to admit / acknowledge (a mistake, a fact)
cards.Example: 我承认这次是我错了。 wǒ chéngrèn zhè cì shì wǒ cuò le: I admit I was wrong this time

cards.English: to emphasize / stress
cards.Example: 他一再强调这只是他个人的看法。 tā yízài qiángdiào zhè zhǐ shì tā gèrén de kànfǎ: He kept stressing that it was just his personal view
cards.Notes: Common pair: 一再强调 / 反复强调 = stress again and again.

cards.English: to misunderstand / a misunderstanding (between people)
cards.Example: 你误会我的意思了。 nǐ wùhuì wǒ de yìsi le: You've misunderstood what I meant
cards.Notes: 误会 is spoken and about intentions; 误解 is more formal, about ideas or facts.

cards.English: to argue / debate (over an issue)
cards.Example: 他们为这个问题争论了半天。 tāmen wèi zhège wèntí zhēnglùn le bàntiān: They argued about this for ages
cards.Notes: 争论 = argue a point; 吵架 = quarrel angrily.

cards.English: to make sense / have a point (what you say ___)
cards.Example: 你说的也有道理。 nǐ shuō de yě yǒu dàolǐ: You have a point there
cards.Notes: Adding 也 softens it: 'you have a point too' before you push back.

cards.English: to be honest… (sentence opener)
cards.Example: 说实话,我不太喜欢这个方案。 shuō shíhuà, wǒ bú tài xǐhuan zhège fāng'àn: To be honest, I don't really like this plan
cards.Notes: Also 说实在的 / 老实说, same meaning.

cards.English: Actually, I think… (mild contrast with what was just said)
cards.Example: 我倒觉得这样挺好的。 wǒ dào juéde zhèyàng tǐng hǎo de: Actually, I think it's fine like this
cards.Notes: 倒 marks a gentle contrary view; softer than 但是我觉得.

cards.English: objection / complaint (to have a problem with someone)
cards.Example: 大家对新规定意见很大。 dàjiā duì xīn guīdìng yìjiàn hěn dà: Everyone has big complaints about the new rule
cards.Notes: 意见 is 'opinion', but 对…有意见 means 'have a problem with'.

cards.English: consensus (reach a ___)
cards.Example: 我们还没达成共识。 wǒmen hái méi dáchéng gòngshí: We haven't reached a consensus yet
cards.Notes: Fixed collocation: 达成共识.

cards.English: to give ground / make a concession
cards.Example: 双方都得让一步。 shuāngfāng dōu děi ràng yí bù: Both sides have to give a little
cards.Notes: Separable: 让一步 = give a little ground.

cards.English: objective / unbiased
cards.Example: 你这么说不太客观。 nǐ zhème shuō bú tài kèguān: That's not very objective of you
cards.Notes: Opposite: 主观 (subjective).

cards.English: to point out (a problem, a mistake)
cards.Example: 他指出了报告里的几个问题。 tā zhǐchū le bàogào lǐ de jǐ ge wèntí: He pointed out a few problems in the report

cards.English: to openly question / challenge (a claim, data)
cards.Example: 很多专家质疑这个数据。 hěn duō zhuānjiā zhìyí zhège shùjù: Many experts question these figures
cards.Notes: Formal. 质疑 is voiced, public challenge; 怀疑 is privately doubting.

cards.English: controversial / disputed
cards.Example: 这个话题很有争议。 zhège huàtí hěn yǒu zhēngyì: This topic is very controversial

cards.English: one-sided (of a view or argument)
cards.Example: 你这么看问题有点片面。 nǐ zhème kàn wèntí yǒudiǎn piànmiàn: That's a bit of a one-sided way to look at it
cards.Notes: Opposite: 全面 (comprehensive, all-round).

cards.English: I see what you mean, but…
cards.Pinyin: wǒ míngbai nǐ de yìsi, búguò…
cards.Notes: A polite way to disagree. 不过 is softer than 但是.

cards.English: Let's agree to disagree.
cards.Hanzi: 那我们就各自保留意见吧。
cards.Pinyin: nà wǒmen jiù gèzì bǎoliú yìjiàn ba
cards.Notes: 保留意见 = keep one's own view.

cards.English: It depends on the specific situation.
cards.Notes: Also shorter: 看情况 (it depends).
